support.heading: Help keep this work free
message: The transmissions are already free — at the source, and here. I organize them into a Codex, with AI as a bridge, because I love it.

Working on your own remembering is already support. Sit with a topic. Let it land. Sharing one, or showing up in the community, is the same work. If you are moved to give, it covers power, internet, and the AI tools that let me keep going.
